productionContract.script: 代码动画是怎么做出来的：每一帧画面都由帧号算出来。帧号进入时间线函数，算出这一帧的所有数值（位置、压扁、颜色、相机）；画面组件只按这些数值画图；无头浏览器把每一帧截成图片；ffmpeg 把图片合成视频。因为每帧只取决于帧号，所以可以并行渲染，也可以不渲染、直接算数值来检查动作。
productionContract.subtitleAuthority: none (no narration); explicit beat timeline below is the timing authority
productionContract.brand: none; neutral dark studio palette borrowed from shot-library ProductionSystem 'studio' theme
technicalFacts: Remotion: useCurrentFrame() gives the frame number; every value is computed from it
Remotion renders by opening the composition in headless Chromium and screenshotting each frame
ffmpeg stitches the frame images into a video file
Because each frame only depends on frame + props, frames can be rendered out of order / in parallel (Remotion --concurrency)
A pure timeline function can be evaluated in Node without rendering pixels
productionContract.assets: none external; all shapes drawn in React/SVG; system fonts PingFang SC / Menlo

demoMotion.note: The film explains itself with a tiny demo: a ball whose x, squash, color and camera zoom are computed by demoTimeline(demoFrame). The same function drives the value panel, the scene panel, the thumbnails and the final curve chart, so the numbers on screen are the real numbers drawn.

beats.statement: 代码动画是怎么做出来的？每一帧画面都由帧号算出来。
beats.purpose: hook: pose the question and introduce the single input
beats.visibleTransformation: frame chip appears at center and its number starts counting 0,1,2…
beats.outputState: a large ticking frame number is the only object on stage
beats.handoff: the chip itself shrinks and travels left toward the timeline function

beats.purpose: show the frame number is the only input of a function
beats.visibleTransformation: timeline(frame) box assembles at left; chip slides into its input slot; box border lights on contact
beats.outputState: chip docked in timeline-fn input, still counting
beats.handoff: box emits four output wires to the right

beats.statement: 算出这一帧的所有数值：位置、压扁、颜色、相机
beats.purpose: make 'all values for this frame' concrete
beats.inputState: timeline-fn lit, wires drawing to the right
beats.visibleTransformation: four rows (x 位置, squash 压扁, color 颜色, camera 相机) appear one after another; each shows a live number + bar that changes with the chip number
beats.outputState: value panel with four live values
beats.viewerFocus: the four numbers changing in lockstep with the frame chip
beats.handoff: wires extend from the value rows to the scene panel

beats.statement: 画面组件只按这些数值画图
beats.purpose: show the scene is a pure drawing of the values, nothing else
beats.visibleTransformation: Scene(values) viewport opens at right; ball drawn at x, squashed by squash, tinted by color, viewport zoomed by camera; each row pulses when its property visibly changes the ball
beats.outputState: ball moving in the viewport, synced with values
beats.handoff: a browser chrome frame closes around the scene panel

beats.statement: 无头浏览器把每一帧截成图片
beats.visibleTransformation: headless-browser chrome wraps the scene; on each captured frame a white flash fires and a numbered PNG thumbnail drops into the film strip at the bottom
beats.outputState: film strip filling with numbered PNG thumbnails that show the ball at different positions
beats.handoff: film strip slides right toward ffmpeg

beats.visibleTransformation: thumbnails stream into the ffmpeg box; a video.mp4 bar with a progress fill grows on its right
beats.handoff: film strip splits into three lanes

beats.statement: 每帧只取决于帧号，所以可以并行渲染
beats.visibleTransformation: strip splits into 3 worker lanes labeled 帧 0–19 / 20–39 / 40–59; all three fill at the same time, out of order
beats.handoff: scene panel dims; value panel grows

beats.statement: 也可以不渲染，直接算数值来检查动作
beats.visibleTransformation: browser + scene dim with label 不截图; the value panel transforms into a curve chart that traces x and squash over frames 0–59 directly from timeline(); squash dips get check marks
beats.outputState: curve chart with checks; whole system held still
beats.handoff: final hold from frame 630 to 659 (all children frozen on display frame 630)
